title: A sound sequence: data/sound/sequences/<sequence>.json
description: A sequence of the sound archive (swan_sound_data.sdat): the music, sound effect or cry that a SEQ_* constant of data/constants/sound.txt plays. Its notes are <sequence>.seq beside it, in the text of tools/data/sseq.py, or <sequence>.mid, a MIDI file that tools/data/midi_sseq.py converts. tools/data/sound_data.py packs the archive.

bank.description: The instrument bank that the sequence plays, from data/constants/sound_banks.txt

channel_priority.description: The priority of its notes for the sound channels: a note takes a channel from a lower one

player_priority.description: Its priority for its player: a sequence that starts on a player with no room stops a lower one

player.description: The player it plays on, from data/sound/archive.json: PLAYER_BGM for the music

shares_data_with.description: Another sequence whose notes this one plays, in place of a file of its own

loop.description: Whether the sequence loops: between the MIDI markers "[" and "]" (or "loopStart" and "loopEnd"), or over the whole song if it has none. Default: whether it has a marker

priority.description: Each track's priority, which adds to channel_priority. Default 64

bend_range.description: The pitch bend range in semitones, unless the MIDI sets it with RPN 0. Default 2

transpose.description: Semitones to add to every note. Default 0

velocity_curve.description: An exponent for the MIDI velocities: values above 1 soften quiet notes. Default 1
